# Legacy Nischhal Portfolio Website

This repository contains an older one-page portfolio created during an earlier stage of Nischhal Subba's design and frontend journey.

It should be treated as an archived learning and evolution project, not as the current professional portfolio or source of current contact, employment, service, skill, or project information.

## Current portfolio

https://nischhalsubba.com.np/

## Current repository

https://github.com/Nischhalsubba/nischhalsubba.com.np

## Legacy technology

- Static HTML
- CSS
- Bootstrap
- jQuery plugins
- Magnific Popup
- Parallax and smooth-scroll interactions

## Content warning

Personal details, skill percentages, project images, services, blog cards, social links, resume links, and contact information in this repository may be outdated, incomplete, or placeholder content. Use the current production portfolio for accurate information.
